item.title: [MAJOR] Claude: Some users unable to sign up with Apple on the Claude iOS app
item.description: Status: investigating. Impact: major. Latest: We are investigating an issue with Sign in with Apple on the Claude iOS app, which is mainly affecting new accounts. New users can sign up with Google or email instead. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

item.title: [MINOR] OpenAI: Delayed Costs Data in the Compliance API
item.description: Status: monitoring. Impact: minor. Latest: We are monitoring the affected services to confirm recovery. Delays in cost data are still expected.

item.title: [NONE] OpenAI: Elevated errors with ChatGPT billing and Ads billing
item.description: Status: resolved. Impact: none. Latest: All affected services are operating normally again. We’re sorry for the disruption, and we appreciate your patience.

item.title: [MAJOR] Claude: Elevated purchasing errors on claude.ai
item.description: Status: resolved. Impact: major. Latest: The issue affecting purchases and plan changes on claude.ai has been resolved, and delayed plan changes and payments have now been applied. Impact occurred from 18:34 PT on November 13 / 02:34 UTC on November 14 to 20:03 PT on November 13 / 04:03 UTC on November 14.

item.title: [MINOR] OpenAI: Elevated errors affecting the Microsoft 365 connector
item.description: Status: resolved. Impact: minor. Latest: All affected services are operating normally again. We’re sorry for the disruption, and we appreciate your patience.

item.title: [MAJOR] Claude: Elevated errors affecting the Microsoft 365 connector
item.description: Status: resolved. Impact: major. Latest: This incident has been resolved. From 08:03 PT / 16:03 UTC on November 12 to 08:40 PT / 16:40 UTC on November 13, mail, calendar and search tools in the Microsoft 365 connector and Claude for Outlook returned errors for many requests because of a Microsoft 365 service incident. Microsoft is still completing its recovery, so you may see occasional errors or delays.
